notes.title: TODAY'S the DAY + New VERSION, bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hi!
Yes, today is our Launch day!
We did some bug fixes over the past weeks, and we continue to do so on a daily basis.
Here are the recent fixes:

* Save Game Fixes
* Menu Fixes 
* Some Puzzles were optimized
* Some Puzzles were fixed to be slicker and easier to control
* Major Optimization (Baking Static Mesh) to give us more fps
* Fix Many Localization Fonts issue (ArMenu + Clues ) in Chinese and Cyrillic

And many more small bugs. The big, big focus was to arrange the Save Game system and the puzzles (on the clues, but mostly on the manipulaiotn, the controls of them.)

We hope you'll enjoy the game as much as we worked hard on it! We didi it with very limited means, but with all of our heart and soul!

Cheers!
Epsilon Team: Martin, Anne, Sabrina, Nancy, Nicolas, Raphie, Mo, Jade, Valentin, David and Stephane.
